scope.intrinsic_LED_and_RX: Frozen LED static fit, CLED=200fF, optical tau200ps, RX1GHz threshold62.5uA and original PRBS sampler. No optical measurement or reliability signoff.
scope.data_fixed: fixed 3.6V high for FF disturbance; low0V, unchanged20ps edge
scope.data_tracking: high follows actual VDD(t), low0V, unchanged20ps bit transition; behavioral source current sensed by VDATA and energy uses actual DATA voltage
scope.energy: all terminal supply voltages sampled, actual v(t)*i(t); DATA included. VBIT has zero load; BTRACK terminal energy counted once via series VDATA. No upstream generation losses.
scope.matrix: bounded one-factor and declared combined-corner stress, not exhaustive signoff

scope_clarifications.identity_audit: An all_checks_passed identity audit does not assert functional/device pass.
scope_clarifications.legacy_stress_screen_V: Manifest inherited3.63V is historical03v3 uniform metric; read actual analysis.device_specific_screen per MOS:03v3 3.63V and06v0 conservative6.0V. Gate-specific limits remain distinguished from full reliability.
scope_clarifications.DATA: Use actual case.data_mode/data_high_V/rail_profiles and sampled waveform; inheritedfixed3.6V description describes initialbaselineFF control, not everyfinalcase.
scope_clarifications.DC: combined_screen_passed onDC is device voltage screening only; compare current to threshold separately, not transientRX pass.
scope_clarifications.resistor_corners: Only PDKpolyRIN corner changes; ideal externalB RREF88.386106k and RDUMMY28k tolerances not covered.
